ModMetaData.name: Custom Base Framework
ModMetaData.author: Evil Eye Guy
ModMetaData.description:
A framework for building settlements, villages, dungeons and quest sites out of hand drawn pieces instead of one frozen layout per map.
Pieces store roles, not defNames. A wall is WALL, a floor is FLOOR_INTERIOR. A palette turns those roles into actual things and terrain, so the same cottage is a log hut in a poor village and a marble townhouse in a rich city, decided by style tags.
Work in progress. Currently: piece format, palettes, stamper, settlement generator, map hookup and dev tools.
